slug.description: URL-safe identifier; derived from `name` if blank.
slug.title: Slug

name.description: New display name for the agency.
name.title: Name

AutomationRulesUpsertPayload.description:
Body for `PUT /v1/admin/agencies/{agency_id}/automation`.

Automation rules persist to `agency_automation_rules`. `platforms` is
intentionally NOT accepted here — the canonical owner is
`agency_reel_defaults` (the `/defaults` endpoint).

approval_required.description: When true, reels are parked in `awaiting_review` until a human approves them; when false, the pipeline auto-publishes.
approval_required.title: Approval Required

publish_days.description: Three-letter lowercase weekdays when auto-publish runs.
publish_days.title: Publish Days

publish_window_end.description: Latest publish time of day, in `HH:MM` (24h, agency timezone).
publish_window_end.title: Publish Window End

publish_window_start.description: Earliest publish time of day, in `HH:MM` (24h, agency timezone).
publish_window_start.title: Publish Window Start

trigger_on_status.description: Property statuses that trigger reel generation.
trigger_on_status.title: Trigger On Status

AutomationRulesUpsertPayload.title: AutomationRulesUpsertPayload

BrandSettingsUpsertPayload.description:
Body for `PUT /v1/admin/agencies/{agency_id}/brand`.

Every field is optional so the frontend can save one input at a time
without resending the whole brand block. Omitted fields preserve the
previously stored value (or fall back to the per-section default if
none was stored before).

font_family.description: Heading font used in the reel and the outro card.
font_family.title: Font Family

intro_logo_object_key.description: Object storage key for the intro-card logo asset.
intro_logo_object_key.title: Intro Logo Object Key

logo_object_key.description: Object storage key for the watermark logo asset.
logo_object_key.title: Logo Object Key

logo_position.description: Watermark anchor on the rendered reel.
logo_position.title: Logo Position

primary_color.description: Primary brand colour, used for accents and overlays. Hex string.
primary_color.title: Primary Color

secondary_color.description: Secondary brand colour, used for backgrounds and outro cards.
secondary_color.title: Secondary Color

BrandSettingsUpsertPayload.title: BrandSettingsUpsertPayload

GlobalWordPressSourceUpsertPayload.description:
Body for ``PUT /v1/admin/wordpress-sources/{site_id}``.

The ``site_id`` is taken from the URL (the value WordPress posts as
``rest_domain`` in the webhook body). Omit ``agency_id`` to have the
endpoint create a placeholder agency on the fly.

agency_id.description: UUID of the owning agency. Leave blank to auto-create.
agency_id.title: Agency Id

normalized_host.description: Hostname stored verbatim. Defaults to the lowercased ``site_id``.
normalized_host.title: Normalized Host

site_url.description: Canonical site URL (used for display only).
site_url.title: Site Url

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the WordPress site.
source_name.title: Source Name

webhook_secret.description: Optional shared secret to require when WEBHOOK_DISABLE_SECURITY is off.
webhook_secret.title: Webhook Secret

GlobalWordPressSourceUpsertPayload.title: GlobalWordPressSourceUpsertPayload

encrypted_data.description: Encrypted user-context blob received from the GHL parent frame.
encrypted_data.title: Encrypted Data

location_id.description: GHL location id whose stored access token should be probed.
location_id.title: Location Id

location_id.description: The GHL sub-account location id the user opened the app from.
location_id.title: Location Id

user_id.description: The GHL user id resolved from the iframe SSO payload or fallback.
user_id.title: User Id

name.description: Display name shown in the admin.
name.title: Name

site_id.description: Lowercased hostname identifying the WordPress site. Must match the value sent as `rest_domain` in webhook bodies.
site_id.title: Site Id

webhook_secret.description: Optional per-site secret used to verify webhook signatures.
webhook_secret.title: Webhook Secret

webhook_secret.description: Optional shared secret used to verify webhook signatures. Send the key (even with empty string) to clear it.
webhook_secret.title: Webhook Secret

MusicTrackPatchPayload.description:
Body for `PUT /v1/admin/agencies/{agency_id}/music/{music_id}`.

Every field is optional: omitted fields preserve the previously stored
value.
MusicTrackPatchPayload.title: MusicTrackPatchPayload

MusicTrackPayload.description:
Body for `POST /v1/admin/agencies/{agency_id}/music`.

Used to register a brand new music track. The `id` is generated server
side; the client only supplies the descriptive fields.

display_name.description: Human-readable label shown in the music picker.
display_name.title: Display Name

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the track in seconds. Must be positive.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

is_default.description: When true, this track is highlighted as the default for new reels.
is_default.title: Is Default

object_key.description: Object storage key for the audio asset.
object_key.title: Object Key

MusicTrackPayload.title: MusicTrackPayload

ProviderConnectionUpsertPayload.description:
Body for `POST` and `PUT /v1/admin/agencies/{agency_id}/ghl-connection`.

Backwards-compatible with the legacy admin panel: it ships the shape
`{location_id, user_id, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, status}`.
The router maps that to the new `(external_id, secrets, config)` model
before calling the use case, so the panel keeps working without changes.

access_token.description: OAuth access token. Stored encrypted; never echoed back.
access_token.title: Access Token

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 expiry of the access token. Optional.
expires_at.title: Expires At

location_id.description: GoHighLevel sub-account location id stored as `external_id`.
location_id.title: Location Id

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token. Stored encrypted; optional.
refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

user_id.description: GHL user id; falls back to `manual` when omitted.
user_id.title: User Id

ProviderConnectionUpsertPayload.title: ProviderConnectionUpsertPayload

ReelDefaultsUpsertPayload.description:
Body for `PUT /v1/admin/agencies/{agency_id}/defaults`.

Defaults is the canonical owner of `platforms` (which channels reels
publish to). The free-form `settings` dict mirrors the frontend
INITIAL_DEFAULTS shape (currency, language, aspect, resolution, fps,
subFont, subSize, subBgStyle, musicVolume, kenBurns, introCard,
outroCard, etc.) and is merged shallow with the previously stored
object.

caption_template.description: Default caption template used by the publisher.
caption_template.title: Caption Template

duration_seconds.description: Target reel duration in seconds when no override is given.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

intro_enabled.description: Whether to render an intro card at the start of every reel.
intro_enabled.title: Intro Enabled

music_id.description: Identifier of the music track used by default.
music_id.title: Music Id

platforms.description: Social platforms the reel should be published to.
platforms.title: Platforms

settings.description: Free-form rendering defaults (frontend INITIAL_DEFAULTS shape). Stored verbatim under `agency_reel_defaults.settings` (jsonb).
settings.title: Settings

ReelDefaultsUpsertPayload.title: ReelDefaultsUpsertPayload

ReelProfileUpsertPayload.description:
Raw, low-level reel-profile body. Used by the admin "Reel settings" tab.

Prefer the per-section endpoints under ``/v1/admin/agencies/{id}/...``
(``/brand``, ``/defaults``, ``/automation``, ``/social-templates``,
``/music``) for any flow that only needs to edit a single concern.

extra_settings.description: Free-form bag of extras. When supplied it REPLACES the free-form `settings` document on `agency_reel_defaults` wholesale — use the per-section endpoints for safe partial edits.
extra_settings.title: Extra Settings

platforms.description: Social platforms the reel should be published to.
platforms.title: Platforms

ReelProfileUpsertPayload.title: ReelProfileUpsertPayload

ScriptedRenderResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /v1/videos/scripted/render`.

The endpoint accepts the manifest and enqueues a `scripted_render` job;
the actual ffmpeg rendering happens asynchronously in the worker. Clients
that need the resolved artifact paths poll a separate endpoint (not
exposed in this feature) once the worker completes.
ScriptedRenderResponse.title: ScriptedRenderResponse

SocialTemplatesReplacePayload.description:
Body for `PUT /v1/admin/agencies/{agency_id}/social-templates`.

Replaces the whole template block: every existing per-platform row is
dropped and re-inserted from the supplied `templates` map. Each key is
a platform identifier (`instagram`, `tiktok`, `facebook`, `linkedin`,
`youtube`, `gbp`) and the value is the description template.

templates.description: Mapping of platform identifier to description template. Unknown keys are accepted so future platforms do not need a schema bump. Empty map drops all stored templates.
templates.title: Templates

SocialTemplatesReplacePayload.title: SocialTemplatesReplacePayload

get.description: Returns 200 once the runtime can accept work, 503 otherwise. Body shape: `{status, dispatcher_accepting_jobs}`.
get.summary: Readiness probe

get.description: Always returns 200 with `{"status": "ok"}` once the process is up.

schema.title: Response Health Live Health Live Get

get.summary: Liveness probe

get.description: Same response as `/health`. Provided for orchestrator conventions.
get.summary: Readiness probe (alias)

get.description: Returns every agency known to the backend, together with the currently linked WordPress sources, the saved GoHighLevel connection, and the derived reel-profile snapshot.
get.summary: List every agency

post.description: Creates an empty agency. The slug is derived from `name` if not supplied. After creation the agency has no WordPress sources and no GHL connection.

delete.description: Deletes the agency and relies on FK cascades for linked sources, connections and configuration rows.

get.description: Returns the agency record plus its WordPress sources, the GHL connection and the reel profile snapshot currently persisted for that tenant.
get.summary: Get one agency with its sources, GHL connection and reel profile

patch.description: Partial update: fields not present in the body keep their current value.
patch.summary: Update agency name / slug / timezone / status

get.description: Returns the automation slice: approval requirement, publish window, publish days and trigger statuses. `platforms` is NOT part of this slice — read it from `/defaults`.
get.summary: Read the agency's automation rules

put.description: Replaces only the automation slice. `platforms` is intentionally rejected by the payload — its canonical owner is the `/defaults` endpoint.

get.description: Returns the brand slice of the agency configuration: colours, logo position, logo object keys, font family. Used by the agency-facing **Brand** tab.
get.summary: Read the agency's brand identity

put.description: Replaces only the brand slice of the agency configuration. Fields omitted from the body preserve the previously stored value. Other configuration sections (defaults, automation, social_templates, music) are not touched.

get.description: Returns the defaults slice — platforms, target duration, intro toggle, default music, caption template and the free-form `settings` document used by the **Defaults** tab.
get.summary: Read the agency's reel rendering defaults

put.description: Replaces only the defaults slice. `platforms` is mirrored verbatim to the canonical column (defaults owns this field). `settings` is shallow-merged with the previously stored object so partial updates from one tab do not drop fields written by another.
put.summary: Update the agency's reel rendering defaults

delete.description: Deletes the connection. Subsequent webhooks for this agency will be rejected with `GHL_CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND` until a new connection is attached.

get.description: Returns the saved connection metadata (location id, status, config, presence flags for tokens). The plaintext access and refresh tokens are never returned.
get.summary: Inspect the agency's GoHighLevel connection

post.description: Stores the `location_id` and OAuth tokens for the agency's GHL sub-account. Tokens are encrypted at rest with Fernet; the response never echoes the plaintext access or refresh token.
post.summary: Attach (or replace) the agency's GoHighLevel connection

put.description: Replaces the saved tokens for an agency that already has a GoHighLevel connection. Returns 404 (`GHL_CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND`) if no connection exists yet — use POST to attach one first.

post.description: Calls the GHL accounts endpoint with the stored connection and returns the social accounts the location has linked. Useful to verify that the saved access token still works.

get.description: Returns every music track attached to the agency, ordered by display name. Replaces the legacy `/music-tracks` stub.
get.summary: List the agency's music library

post.description: Adds a track to the agency music library. The `id` is generated server side; the response echoes the saved record.
post.summary: Register a new music track for the agency

delete.summary: Decommission a music track from the agency library

get.summary: Inspect a single music track

put.description: Updates the descriptive fields of a music track. Omitted fields preserve the previously stored value.

get.description: Returns the agency configuration assembled into the legacy `reel_profiles` shape (brand + defaults + automation + social templates + music tracks). Prefer the per-section endpoints — `/brand`, `/defaults`, `/automation`, `/social-templates`, `/music` — when you only need a single concern.
get.summary: Read the aggregated reel profile for an agency

put.description: Accepts the legacy aggregated payload and fans the update out to the typed sections (`brand`, `defaults`, `automation`). Fields omitted from the body preserve the previously stored value. `extra_settings`, when present, replaces the free-form `agency_reel_defaults.settings` document wholesale.
put.summary: Update the aggregated reel profile for an agency

get.description: Returns the most recent reels for the agency, joining the `properties` row, the latest `reels` row, and the most recent `media_revisions` row. Used by the agency Reels dashboard.
get.summary: List the agency's recent reels

get.description: Same shape as one item from the listing endpoint, plus a `has_video` flag and a relative `video_url` to stream the rendered MP4.
get.summary: Get one reel for the agency

post.description:
Two-step action.

1. The reel is moved to `workflow_state='approved'` / `publish_status='pending_publish'` so the editor reflects the new gate immediately.
2. A fresh `reel_publish` job is enqueued from the stored WordPress payload, with `approval_required=False` forced on the `publish_context`. If the original payload or the agency's GHL connection is missing, the response stays 200 with `publish_enqueued=false` so the frontend can render a consistent state.
post.summary: Approve a reel and regenerate (re-publish) it

get.description: Returns every image WordPress shipped for the property, in the order they were ingested. Each entry includes the original `image_url`, the local cached path (when downloaded), and a stable backend URL via `file_url` for locally-cached images.
get.summary: List the property images that fed the reel

get.description: Serves the locally-cached property image at the given position. Returns 404 if the image was never downloaded.
get.summary: Stream one of the property's downloaded image files

get.description: Returns the resolved render manifest for the most recent revision: scenes, durations, music selection, brand overlay placement, subtitle layout.

404.description: No manifest is available for this reel.

get.summary: Get the rendered reel's manifest JSON

post.description: Sets the reel's pipeline state to `rejected` and the publish status to `rejected` so it stays out of the publish queue.

get.description: Streams the most recent rendered MP4 for the reel. Honours the `Range` header so HTML5 `<video>` players can seek and lazy-load. Returns 404 if no rendered video exists yet.

206.description: Range chunk (used by HTML5 video for seeking).

404.description: No rendered video for this reel.

get.summary: Stream the rendered MP4 for a reel

get.description: Wraps the GoHighLevel accounts API using the agency's stored connection. Always returns 200; if the agency has no GHL connection (or the call fails) the body has `connected: false` or `items: []` plus a `reason` code so the frontend can render an empty state without crashing.
get.summary: List social accounts linked to the agency's GHL location

get.description: Returns the templates map keyed by platform identifier (`instagram`, `tiktok`, `facebook`, `linkedin`, `youtube`, `gbp`). Used by the **Social** tab to render the publish caption.
get.summary: Read the agency's per-platform description templates

put.description: Replaces the entire templates block: every existing per-platform row is dropped and re-inserted from the supplied map. Send an empty map to remove all templates.
put.summary: Replace the agency's per-platform description templates

get.summary: List the ingestion sources of an agency

post.description: Creates an ingestion source bound to the agency. The `site_id` is the value WordPress posts as `rest_domain` in webhook bodies.
post.summary: Register a new ingestion source for an agency

get.summary: Inspect a single ingestion source

get.description: Flat global view for source provisioning. The agency-scoped endpoint (`GET /v1/admin/agencies/{id}/sources`) is preferred for new flows.
get.summary: List every WordPress source across all agencies

get.description: Looks up a WordPress source by the `site_id` (the value the `rest_domain` body field carries on the inbound webhook). Returns 404 with code `ADMIN_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND` if no source is registered for that site.
get.summary: Get a single WordPress source by site_id

put.description: Upserts the WordPress source identified by `site_id`. Will create the agency on the fly if `agency_id` is omitted. Reassigning a source to a different agency is rejected.
put.summary: Create or update a WordPress source by site_id

post.description: Resolves the agency from the body's `rest_domain` (or `X-WP-Site-Id` header), validates security headers/HMAC, and enqueues a `reel_publish` job. Returns 202 with the new `event_id`/`job_id`.
post.summary: Receive a property webhook from a WordPress site

post.description: Decrypts the embedded HighLevel userData blob with GO_HIGH_LEVEL_APP_SHARED_SECRET and returns the resolved session context.
post.summary: Decrypt the GoHighLevel iframe SSO payload

post.description: Given the active location_id and user_id, returns whether the location has a saved access token and which agency it belongs to.
post.summary: Create or refresh the agency-bound session for a GHL location

post.description: Identical to the agency-scoped GoHighLevel connection test but keyed by location_id rather than agency_id.
post.summary: Probe a GHL location's saved token and list its social accounts

get.description: Returns one row per agency that has a stored GHL connection, with access tokens redacted. Used as a quick global health check.
get.summary: List every saved GoHighLevel connection

post.description: Validates the manifest's tenant fields (`site_id`, `source_property_id`), enqueues a `scripted_render` job, and returns 202 with `event_id` and `job_id`. The worker performs the ffmpeg render asynchronously.
post.summary: Enqueue a scripted property video render
